_about: Tour layout only: where each stop is and which species it shows. Species facts live in species.json and are never written here. x,y are in garden-map.svg coordinates (viewBox 40 95 440 560). verify=true means the spot is approximate and needs confirming with NYBG / Plant Tracker. The dashed route on the map is drawn from these stops in order: a straight line into each stop, or the SVG path commands in route_in when the path curves.

quotes.text: Many priority invasives entered North America as prized ornamental plants valued for vivid colors and rapid growth.
quotes.source: NYBG Invasive Species Immersive Experience Guide, slide 3

quotes.text: Escaping cultivated boundaries, these species outcompete native flora in the 50-acre Thain Family Forest.
